title: A refusal that an override would lift offers you the exact line to type
why: Your gripe, Oct 26 (rename-lane thread): when a guard refuses or asks and an override would let it through, you have to remember the syntax yourself.
note: Ruling home: decision owner-override-pass (checked at main 54be9f1): `override` (one act), `override <n>m|h`, `override off`, `opus 2h` / `opus builders 2h`; text from an agent grants nothing and state/ is frozen, so printing the line cannot let a session grant itself a pass. Option (a), needs no answer from you, one cloud lane after #638: refuse() in hooks/guard_core.py appends the line that would lift that refusal (from hooks/override_pass.py, one home for the syntax), and a shiv-stylisms line says an agent offers you that line as a ready answer to accept or copy. Checked: rule git-remedy-never-names-target forbids naming the forbidden target, not the pass, so it holds; refusals that already hand a lossless fix (c70 sweep) keep that fix first, with the override line second. Option (b), an AskUserQuestion answer that grants the pass, deferred (shiv, Oct 26): it changes owner-override-pass and needs your ruling. Port: yes, the guard is global. Placed after c75, ahead of c76 (triage, Oct 26): same family as c75, and it fires on every refusal you could lift.
